text: Building, maintaining, and running an eCommerce business on a popular eCommerce platform like WooCommerce involves numerous processes. One of the first things a merchant needs to ensure is the store’s security. According to research, about 29% of the total traffic on your website comes from malicious sources like hackers. With the eCommerce community rapidly expanding and online shopping continuously evolving, it has become crucial to boost the website’s safety walls to ensure a secure shopping experience for your buyers. WooCommerce already has in-built features that make it entirely safe as an eCommerce platform. Your business deals with a lot of sensitive information daily, so it is recommended that you follow the WooCommerce security guidelines to prevent loss of data or any form of cybercrime. A single layer of security may not be enough to satisfy the needs of some businesses. For this reason, we have brought together several tips in this article that can help you enhance WooCommerce security to keep your online store safe. Table of Contents Is WooCommerce Secure in 2022? WooCommerce Website Security Issues in 2022 Top Security Tips to Keep Your WooCommerce Store Secure Use Robust Plugins Secure WooCommerce Login Limit Brute Force Login Attempts Use Strong Passwords SSL Certificates Enable Two-factor Authentication Spam Submissions Safeguard Wp-config.php Files Restrict Content Records Backup Your Website Rename Login Page Install a Firewall Set Up an Activity Log Malware Scanning Use Dissimilar Username Adjust FTP settings Utilize Geoblocking Update User Management Policy Restrict Editing of Certain Files Regular Website Updates Security Plugins Security is a Priority for WooCommerce Websites Final Note – WooCommerce Security in 2022 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) – WooCommerce Security Is WooCommerce Secure in 2022? WooCommerce, a robust platform built on the sturdy foundation of WordPress , is renowned for its security, making it a trusted choice for merchants worldwide. As eCommerce continues to proliferate, so do cybersecurity threats, intensifying the need for reliable security systems. Fortunately, WooCommerce responds to this demand with stringent security features, consistent updates, and fortified defenses to safeguard against cybercrimes. While WooCommerce’s inherent security is commendable, it’s important to note that enhancing it with additional layers provides an extra barrier against external threats like cyber attacks and hacking attempts. Following best security practices and guidelines can help augment WooCommerce’s security, providing an even more secure environment for online transactions. Install the WooCommerce platform for your eCommerce business today Talk To Experts WooCommerce Website Security Issues in 2022 The Covid-19 pandemic impacted everything, and an industry giant like WooCommerce was no exception. The leading platform recently got caught up in a web of cybersecurity issues. Although the complications were rather severe, it was nothing that couldn’t be resolved with quick and efficient solutions.  According to estimates, more than 5 million websites are installed with WooCommerce Plugin. It implies that more than 5 million websites are at risk if they do not find a timely fix for their WooCommerce vulnerabilities. A discussion on WooCommerce cybersecurity issues and their solution becomes all the more relevant owing to this fact.  There were four major WooCommerce security breaches with WooCommerce platforms. Let’s take a look below.  Problem I: Owing to the pandemic, a slew of online shoppers started prowling the internet. Hence, the primary issue is too many login attempts. Hackers used bot networks to log in to the admin panel.  Solution: Installing a WP Plugin like Wordfence will block unknown URL addresses that repeatedly enter wrong passwords. Problem II: The second issue is the absence of data encryption which might lead to hackers stealing sensitive data like usernames, email addresses, bank details, credit/debit card details, etc  Solution: It would be best to have third-party app integrations like SSL certificates to protect your store’s data.  Problem III: Plugin conflicts arising from installing too many plugins for security is the third major issue.  Solution: The only way out is to not rely on too many plugins for security and stick to an SSL certificate.  Problem IV : The final issue is the unavailability of the auto-update option. It’s crucial to update your store to keep it safe, but users must manually check for updates every day since auto-update is unavailable. Solution: Using WP plugins like Companion Auto Update could help ensure regular updates. Discover additional tips to secure your WooCommerce store from cyber attacks Know More Top Security Tips to Keep Your WooCommerce Store Secure Want to enhance the security of your WooCommerce store? Follow the tips below. These expert tips will help you circumvent WooCommerce security vulnerabilities. 1. Use Robust Plugins Plugins and extensions are usually a great way of expanding the functions of your store. However, most of these extensions do not follow the standard quality. Check the performance of the third-party integration, its reviews, and the app’s quality. It is best to stick with reputed brands, as they do not compromise on the quality or integrity of their products. Remember never to download free versions of premium extensions or plugins from external third-party sources as they include malware. It can install viruses in your system, leading to repercussions like loss of data files, consumer information, etc. That is why it is ideal to avoid downloading them at all. Lastly, ensure to update all of the store’s plugins, extensions, and third-party integrations so you can work with efficient apps and benefit from the latest updates. 2. Secure WooCommerce Login The WooCommerce login page is perhaps the most vulnerable point of your store. These four steps will ensure that the login page is secure. First, you can install security extensions to analyze and identify unknown IP addresses. It notifies you whenever someone tries to log in to your page and repeatedly enters the wrong password. Accordingly, you can take steps to block the hacker’s IP address from entering your administration login page in the future. It is much safer to use email ids instead of usernames to log in to your store. Even though the store will ask you to enter your username as part of its default settings, you can change it under the basic settings and connect to your store via your unique email address. 3. Limit Brute Force Login Attempts WooCommerce security guidelines suggest that you limit the number of times anyone can complete a login attempt to enter your store. It is a deliberate effort to identify malicious IP addresses before blocking them. Hackers these days are using advanced technology to guess your password and enter your store, making your eCommerce business significantly vulnerable. To prevent this, WooCommerce is compatible with several plugins that act as a barrier to stop defaulters from entering your store and stealing data.  4. Use Strong Passwords Creating a strong password for your login page is the oldest ace up one’s sleeve to ensure your account is secure. You can follow several guidelines listed below to confirm if your password is strong enough for your account.  Use lowercase, uppercase, symbols, and letters for your password. Do not use your name, birthday or anniversary dates, or other personal phrases that one can easily guess Make sure you have a separate unique password for each of your accounts The longer and more complicated your password is, the harder it is for anyone to crack it WordPress already has a built-in secure password generator that gives you alternatives. It churns out complicated password combinations. So if you are confused or not sure how to make a solid password, you can generate one from WordPress. 5. SSL Certificates Almost every other store has an SSL certificate. It’s relatively common to host a store with one. Business owners and merchants can buy this certificate from an accredited organization. They can also access it through hosting services like Cloudways and third parties that offer the certification free of cost. SSL certificates are beneficial to your store as they bring more potential visitors and site visits. Search engines like Google accept installing these certificates as an SEO ranking factor for websites. Thus, it will not only stop hackers from accessing your transactions and sensitive consumer data but will also play a role in improving your SEO score. 6. Enable Two-factor Authentication People can log in to your WooCommerce account if they have access to your email or any other account you use for logging in. It will enable them to gather enough information to change your password and log in to your account. Two-factor authentication 2FA is an excellent way to ensure all your accounts are safe against intruders. It adds an extra layer of protection to your account. With 2FA, there is a mandatory second step one needs to follow to log in. Typically, it would be best to have your smartphone validate and verify the login process. It asks you to tap on a code that flashes on your login screen. This way, the system can confirm you are the owner and give you access to the account. 7. Spam Submissions Most of the forms on your WooCommerce store are vulnerable to malicious attacks and spam submissions. Payment forms are excluded from being subjected to requests of such nature and objective. For instance, unsecured user registration forms part of your WooCommerce store will lead to hundreds of spam submissions. You will need to put in extra effort to go through them and pick actual customer forms. It is a tiring process, and you may miss a few. That is why it is recommended you secure them to avoid confusion. There are plugins available on WooCommerce Suite that can function as a protection against spam submissions.  8. Safeguard Wp-config.php Files Wp-config.php is one of the most crucial files in your system because it contains a considerable amount of sensitive information about your store. For instance, your WordPress or WooCommerce security details or passwords, database connection information, data about your clients, and more. If hackers access wp-config.php files and tamper with them, your store will suffer incalculable damage. To prevent this, you must restrict access to the files to everyone but yourself. You can also make a new config.php file and transfer all the sensitive data from the main one to this file. It will protect your store’s data if someone manages to access your wp-config.php files. 9. Restrict Content Records  Unethical people often utilize content scrapers to capture all the posts on the site’s blogs. Moreover, enabling free access to all the content records means that each page on your WooCommerce store, even the sensitive ones are accessible. To avoid the security issues that follow this, you can observe specific guidelines. First, you can use plugins to restrict access to your sensitive data. Second, you can create a new folder and add an index.html file. It gives you control over user access, ensuring that only selected users can see the content they are particularly authorized to.  10. Backup Your Website  Backing up your website is one of the few preventive safety guidelines available to safeguard your store. It is not a highly reliable way of protecting your website from hackers, but it is beneficial to protect it from data loss. If your website crashes, you can lose consumer data, new orders, previously placed orders, revenue details, etc. It is thus essential to back up your data to minimize the loss of sensitive and relevant information. This step would also help you tackle the problem of losing data when your website is under attack. During fixing your website and resolving all issues, the backup data might come in handy to restore your WooCommerce store.  Searching to install practical security tools for your eCommerce site? We Can Help 11. Rename Login Page  Renaming your login page means changing the URL address of your login page. Only someone with the exact URL address can access your login page. It reduces 99% of all hacking attempts on your administration panel or online e-commerce store. You can get help from extensions or security teams to change the URL address of your login page. It gives you suggestions of potential login page names. The ordering or modifying process doesn’t take much time and can be carried out by someone with no prior technical knowledge. 12. Install a Firewall Setting up a firewall on your work store will considerably improve security. It will block most threats and potential security breaches before reaching your store. Even if your store comes with an in-built firewall, it is recommended that you install one of your own for safety. A few examples of the most trusted WordPress firewalls are Word fence, Secure, All-in-one WP Security & Firewall, and Theme Security. Merchants or business owners who have an extra budget to hire a developer or possess enough technical knowledge can customize the firewall through a plugin before installing it. It is mainly done to ensure that the firewall caters to the unique needs of your online store.  13. Set Up an Activity Log An activity log is a register that automatically keeps track of everything going down on your website. For example, it notes down every time someone tries to log in to your store, make changes to any web page or a file, changes in the admin panel, alter store configuration, and much more. An activity log is critical for your e-commerce business as it provides you with valuable information you can utilize to troubleshoot website errors and avoid attacks on your website.  14. Malware Scanning Hackers often infiltrate viruses and other malware designed to make your store malfunction and give them an opening to steal all the store’s data. It is less hassle than taking down the entire website. Fortunately, Jetpack Security tools offer a range of services that follows different security functions for your site.One of them is scanning for any suspicious activity, software, or code on your site. A direct email is sent to the business owner to notify them if it finds anything. Site owners or developers can then troubleshoot and rapidly fix the incoming threat. They also provide solutions and quick fixes for most security threats to make your job more convenient and accessible. 15. Use Dissimilar Username  As mentioned earlier, having a solid password is a must to tighten the security of your store, but what happens to the username? It is crucial to change your username to ensure the admin or store name is dissimilar from each other. You can do this by logging into your WordPress admin, navigating to the User, clicking the Add new option, and creating an assigned admin for the WordPress account. Don’t forget to log out and log in again to the new admin account. You can delete the previous account and start posting on the new admin account. The potent combination of a unique admin username and a strong password will make it hard for hackers to crack them.  16. Adjust FTP settings FTP or File Transfer Protocol transfers files between two devices. You can create FTP accounts through your hosting provider that enables you to connect from your computer or laptop to your website server. If any hacker accesses those accounts, they could do relatively severe damage to your work and store by making several alterations to your site. To evade this, you can restrict permissions on these accounts to dramatically reduce the number of potential attacks on your website. Make sure only your FTP account can view the following folders: wp-includes  wp-admin wp-content  the root directory There are further resources and guidelines available on the WordPress codex to aid you in making your FTP account more secure. 17. Utilize Geoblocking Several bots originate from particular countries. As the owner of your website, you know where you can expect authentic traffic on your website. If your website starts giving you reports showing a hike in traffic from a completely different country, you need to worry. It is suspicious to get heavy traffic from another country, and experience tells us that most of the time, they are bots. If you are running a campaign in that country or advertising, it is understandable why you are getting traction on your website. Nonetheless, if there is no visible connection with your website, you need to review the security protocols. The only way to stop this is by implementing Geoblocking, which means you can block entire countries from viewing your website. 18. Update User Management Policy Store administration is not a cakewalk. One may require a seasoned team to ensure the store’s optimal functioning and smooth administration. You might need to share your administrative login IDs and password with the rest of your team. In the long run, there could be possible changes in your group. Some may leave, and some may join afresh. The employees who leave will still have access to your account as they know the ID and the password. Experts recommend that store owners periodically review users who have access to the accounts. During the review, one can decide if someone needs to be removed or added. You can also implement a least privilege policy. It means granting only a minimum allocation of control to a person to perform tasks on the website. 19. Restrict Editing of Certain Files The file editor on your website can be a source of the image of a commerce vulnerability because it allows users to run PHP code. It makes hacking your website relatively more straightforward. File editor is an essential tool to modify themes and plugins directly. Access to the file editor should be restricted to highly crucial employees and yourself. It will decrease the chances of hackers trying to break into your site and making irreversible changes. There is minimal knowledge required to limit the access to the file editor, and it only takes a couple of minutes to perform the chore. 20. Regular Website Updates Frequently updating your website’s themes, plugins, and extensions are only part of the solution. There are other factors of your website that need attention and regular upgrades. For instance, speed, functionality, performance, safety, or specific components are some factors that may improve by implementing measures to upgrade the website. During the updating process, you might find vulnerabilities and bugs that can be removed with quick fixes. 21. Security Plugins It is perhaps one of the most mundane security tips available. However, it is highly recommended by professionals and WooCommerce. While the eCommerce leader has great inbuilt security features, it is simply not enough to keep your store safe. Installing a security plugin from a third-party app is a primary step followed by all business owners and merchants. Ensure that you avail this service from a reliable and legitimate software company. There are numerous options available in the market, and you can choose any depending on your needs. Security is a Priority for WooCommerce Websites  Consumer behavior, trends, recent studies, and research have all pointed out the same thing: an increase in the rate of online shopping. The COVID-19 pandemic has also contributed to the hike in the online buying spree. For these reasons, technology revolving around eCommerce has rapidly progressed to accommodate these changes and give rise to online businesses. It directly impacts the security levels, as it is more crucial than ever to protect many consumers and businesses from cybercrime. WooCommerce has consequently taken steps to make its platform more robust and secure. The strategies, guidelines, or regulations take time as they are multi-step processes. Security tips mentioned in this blog should help you enhance the safety of your WooCommerce store . When running an online store, security is always the priority, as it determines how fast or smooth your store can function. Investment to enhance your security will pay off in the long run and offer you many benefits. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) – WooCommerce Security Can WooCommerce be hacked? Even a prominent eCommerce platform like WooCommerce is vulnerable to security compromises. The platform regularly updates its security features to make a safe business environment for the buyers and sellers. It also communicates specific guidelines and tips to help business owners make their stores safer.  How do I make my WooCommerce store secure? As a business owner, you can do numerous things to make your WooCommerce store more secure. There are various tools available for this purpose. Some of the security guidelines are mentioned in the article above. You can follow one or more depending on the present status of your store. Is WooCommerce safe? WooCommerce is a safe platform for e-commerce businesses. It is famous for providing a secure environment and meeting the demands of rapidly increasing online companies. External factors like malicious hackers can threaten your store, but concrete measures can prevent it. Are security plugins necessary? Security plugins are necessary to ensure the optimum safety of your eCommerce store. Well-known third-party firms provide robust, reliable, avant-garde security plugins to cater to your unique eCommerce business needs. Security plugins will add a supplementary layer of protection to your store.  Is WooCommerce stable to use? WooCommerce is a highly flexible, cost-effective, versatile, and safe platform for all types of e-commerce businesses. It has aided in the success of many start-up online companies. The four types of security vulnerability your WooCommerce store faces are network vulnerabilities, human vulnerabilities, process vulnerabilities, and operating system vulnerabilities. text: The internet is a marketplace where you can find whatever you might be looking for. Jewelry is just one of the many articles merchants sell successfully through eCommerce platforms accessible via the internet. Statistics show that about 29 million people buy jewelry daily, hinting that the ornaments market is flourishing. eCommerce businesses have seized this opportunity by opening up their online jewelry stores . The market share for jewelry is bound to grow at a stable rate in the future due to digital advancements and the increased shift of customers to online shopping. While many factors contributed to buyers making this transformation, the pandemic is the vital driving force. The fashion industry is a gigantic sector comprising minor segments like bags, shoes, hair accessories, ornaments, etc. Pop culture similarly plays a vital role in influencing the fashion taste of adults as they want matching shoes and accessories that go with their stunning outfits. So is the sway of Instagram influencers. Teens today want to look like their Instagram idols. It is one of the major causes behind the boom of the jewelry business in the global market.  Whether you are selling small trinkets or customized handmade jewelry pieces, you can find sufficient resources online to help you make your business a huge success. Besides the contemporary reasons mentioned earlier, jewelry also has a rich cultural background. Jewelry is a precious, timeless commodity that has helped the queens of ancient Egypt to the present-day American teens express love, gratitude, identity, and uniqueness. Another notable aspect of jewelry is its inclusivity. Regardless of gender, caste, or creed, anyone can wear them. Cultural evidence from Ancient India has shown how the royal family members, both men, and women, wore heavy and intricately designed ornaments. Therefore, the importance of jewelry is deep-rooted in civilizations worldwide, and it continues to grow in the modern world. Contact Us Reasons to Sell Jewelry Online  It is the first impulse for shoppers to look things up online before buying them. The internet has created a separate niche for customers to shop whenever and wherever at their own pace. 1. Global Pandemic  Since the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic two years ago, humans have had to make several obligatory changes to their lifestyle to protect themselves from the virus. Instead of stepping out of their homes to shop, people shifted to buying jewelry and clothes online. As for merchants, most of their brick-and-mortar stores had to shut down, and migrating to eCommerce was the only alternative to save their business. A recent survey cited that there had been a 40% hike in the eCommerce business ever since the pandemic started.  2. Less Expenditure  Starting an online store is way more economical than opening up an offline store. The cost of opening an online store is minimal as it does not involve expenses incurred in hiring heavy work staff, renting or leasing charges, machinery, decorations, electricity, etc. You can utilize the saved costs to buy devices and extensions that enhance your online store. Instead of managing costs and mundane governance tasks, you could focus solely on selling your jewelry online.  3. Risk-free Choosing to start your own business online is a boss move, considering the challenges one faces during the pandemic to maintain a physical store. Add to it the tremendous loss that has to be incurred in case the business plummets. Beginning online gives a merchant the leverage to start small and work the way up the business ladder. The expansion could be planned based on the profits made and the product market. During a pandemic where customers think twice before making a purchase, it is easier to entice them with offers, membership discounts, and referrals through an online store.  4. Connect to a Wider Audience Launching an eCommerce store connects you to a global audience. It is nearly impossible to find a person who doesn’t use the internet. You can target audiences based on location, preferences, and buying patterns through pop-ups, social media advertisements, etc. Opening up an online store for your jewelry also adds credibility to the brand’s reputation. People tend to google a brand immediately after hearing good reviews about their products. If your online store has an excellent SEO ranking and relevant content, it will expand your consumer base and increase the conversion rate. 5. Targeting Impulsive Buyers The pandemic has brought about a segment of shoppers who purchase things as a stress buster. Working from home and lockdowns make them have nothing much to do recreationally. They wind up shopping as part of stress relief. Most often than not, they will settle for pretty, tiny, affordable things that give them joy. And jewelry fits right in that slot. It is one of the commonest commodities that buyers tend to hoard to satiate their desire for shopping.  6. Security and Savings   Brick-and-mortar stores are always at risk of getting burglarized, especially if you are in the business of selling precious metals and gemstones. Insurance companies don’t always follow through with their claims. Factors like these make running an offline jewelry store a risky affair. Shifting to an online store will significantly reduce such incidents. Your bank receives online payments, and consequently, any revenues received go directly into your account. It saves you the trip of personally going to the bank and depositing large sums of money at the hazard of getting robbed.  Jewelry Market Research – Trending Jewelry Niches  The expansion of the jewelry market has led to an increase in competition. Brands are investing in technological innovations to enhance their store to heighten their jewelry sales. The cut-throat competition has given rise to a myriad of jewelry market trends.   1. Engagement and Wedding Jewelry  When one thinks about jewelry, a ring is the first article that pops up into anyone’s head. For the high and mighty, a trip to Tiffany’s during the wedding time is a given. For regular folks, buying finger rings for special occasions is unavoidable. It is part of our culture and identity. Couples seldom go out to shop for rings these days when they can sit together and browse through online catalogs to find the best fit for them on the internet at steal deals. Irrespective of the date and time, this is one object among jewelry that will always be in demand.  2. Fast Fashion Jewelry  This type of jewelry is a craze, mostly among young shoppers. It includes jewelry such as necklaces, rings, pendants, bracelets, etc. that tend to go in and out style rapidly. They are mostly made out of inexpensive materials that lower their quality and longevity. For instance, silver replaces platinum, and a copper alloy is used instead of gold. The lower manufacturing costs make them highly affordable to people who religiously follow jewelry trends or those who love to make a fashion statement by accessorizing. Social media influencers on platforms like Instagram and TikTok play a leading role in deciding the tone for such fads. Customers and merchants also keep track of fast fashion jewelry rage through young adult and teenage magazines like Marie Claire, Seventeen, Vogue, and Cosmopolitan.  3. Plated Jewelry  This category is for enthusiastic shoppers who adore the look and feel of high-end jewelry but don’t have the capital to afford it. They look for alternate options like plated jewelry with a core of affordable metal and an outer coating of precious metal. This way, they get to enjoy wearing expensive-looking jewelry without shouldering the hefty price tag. Examples of plated jewelry include nickel or sterling silver coated with pure silver or 14K gold. Merchants are responsible for being 100% transparent with their buyers as customers may be allergic to certain non-precious metals. To avoid losing credibility and ensure a sense of safety, business owners should mention essential product details on their website.  4. Vintage Jewelry  Vintage Jewelry has a unique, elite segment of buyers. They are more popular with antique or jewelry collectors and entrepreneurs who consider them investments. Their buying pattern includes collecting or purchasing historical items from the olden times. Vintage jewelry pieces are popular due to their timelessness and rich past. They make a statement in the fashion industry through their unique appeal. The ornaments are second-hand, which means each piece has its own distinctive story relative to the original jewelry designer, previous owners, and the historical era of creation. They are testimonials of the craftsmanship and cultural heritage of their respective periods, and owning one of them becomes a matter of pride. These stories contribute to increasing the value of the article. The pricing of these items differs based on age, finesse, and history.  5. Body Jewelry  This new market has given a lucrative opportunity to jewelry merchants to expand their product line. There has been a hike in body piercing among the regular population. Body jewelry goes hand in hand with body piercings like belly button rings, tongue rings, eyebrow rings, nose rings, septum rings, lip rings, and the like. As the examples suggest, body jewelry is more intimate than basic ornaments like bracelets and earrings. Body jewelry comes in different designs, shapes, and sizes. Also, the prices change as per trend and materials used in manufacture. Shoppers tend to consider their health, preferences, piercing placement, and comfort level before buying body jewelry. Apart from jewelry for piercings, there is another segment of body jewelry, including clip-on jewelry, body chains, waist chains, leg chains, midi rings, leg chains, toe rings, palm cuffs, and such that people wear to look ‘cool’ and in trend. 6. Handmade Jewelry  Small businesses generally sell this type of jewelry as it could be customized to buyers’ preferences. Since it is a made-to-order jewelry entity, it can take considerable time to create. The vendor puts in the time and effort to handcraft the jewelry from scratch. Hence their pricing may be higher than fast fashion jewelry. The fashion industry procures tons of weight every year, and by encouraging small businesses that focus on making your jewelry with their hands, customers can reduce wastage. Quilling is a well-known technique used by most jewelers to make handmade earrings and necklaces. Upcycled or recycled jewelry, cloth jewelry, shell ornaments, etc., are more examples.  7. Ethical Jewelry  Gen Z shoppers are more socially conscious when compared to previous generations. They feel morally obliged to make conscious purchasing decisions like buying from environmentally sustainable and socially responsible brands. For instance, partners hire people ethically and make sure to pay them the bare minimum wage. Fast fashion usually exploits workers from third-world countries, also engages in child labor activity while paying them less than the set minimum wage under unsafe working conditions. This is one reason why they can afford to sell their products at cheaper rates. Many famous brands have been called out or ‘canceled’ on social media concerning such controversies. With the increase in awareness of sustainability and ethical brands, a notable segment of customers choose ethical jewelry. 8. Fine Jewelry  This category includes expensive, rare metals and gemstones with intricate jewelry designs. Businesses deliberately make them in exclusive, limited stock, so their value shoots up, therefore, making them a valuable investment. Shoppers who can afford to splurge a good amount of money tend to buy fine jewelry. Its rare craftsmanship and materials ensure lifetime longevity. It is one of the reasons why fine jewelry ends up becoming a family heirloom passed down generations. The affluent society collects fine jewelry while regular customers might purchase a couple of pieces during their lifetime. Diamond jewelry, ornaments in platinum or gold encrusted with precious gemstones, pearls or beads, etc., are examples of fine jewelry. Expand your homegrown business into a full-fledged eCommerce jewelry business? We Can Help Steps to Sell Jewelry Online  Are you interested to make maximum profits by selling your jewelry online? Here are some steps you can follow to attain the objective. 1. Research Fashion is a fluid industry. It, therefore, becomes imperative to update yourself constantly to stay on top of trends. You can add or remove products from your website based on the swinging trends. The trendier items you have, the more your engagement and sales rates. One way to learn about the latest trends is to follow jewelry blogs. Diamonds in the Library, Gemologue, and Gem Gossip are incredible blogs written by experts detailing different aspects of the jewelry world. You will find all relevant information in these blogs ranging from the latest trends to interviews with top-notch jewelry and fashion designers. You can also utilize Google Alerts to update you on the newest jewelry trends. Just type jewelry trend and other related words as the keyword, and the search engine will mail you articles that include your keyword. Instagram is the most accessible jewelry trendsetter. You could follow popular jewelry blogs or fashion influencer accounts to get an idea about the most happening trends.  2. Contact Jewelry Suppliers  If you aim only to sell jewelry online, you need a reliable jewelry supplier. You will also need to decide if you are looking for a manufacturer, drop shipper, or wholesaler. You can find suppliers on online marketplaces or Google searches based on your requirements. You will notice that a lot of manufacturers are from China. Order samples from your jewelry supplier before making any professional commitments to maintain quality assurance. Furthermore, decide on details like shipping, cost of buying, duration of the contract, etc., and compare with other suppliers to choose the suitable one. 3. Launching Your Store  It is perhaps the most complicated and crucial step in the process. You must first select an eCommerce platform to open up a store online. SaaS-based eCommerce platforms like WooCommerce, Shopify, BigCommerce, and Wix are ideal for opening up an online jewelry store. Each platform has its set of tools, extensions, and advantages, so pick the one according to your business and personal requirements. Make sure your store falls under one of the favored jewelry niches to keep your store organized and accessible to customers. Add high-quality product images, descriptive product details, and relevant content to your store to improve SEO ranking. Deals and coupon codes will help in attracting more customers. 4. Pricing the Products  Pricing your jewelry is a tedious process. You must ensure to price your product right as too high prices can put off customers, and too low prices will drive your business down. A general rule of thumb is to price the items four times more than the total material and packaging costs. Jewelry suppliers, technological improvements, and other things take up at least 40-60% of your retailing costs. Pricing the items four times more will ensure you don’t lose any money and make a decent percentage of profits. Shipping costs are additional expenses. You can waive shipping costs for your customers if they order above a specific price limit. It will encourage the customers to shop more from your brand.  5. Marketing and Advertising Campaigns  Now that your online store is up and running, it’s time to market your products on the internet. Curate an email list to send subtle promotional emails to potential customers. Add promo codes or discount codes to persuade them to make purchases. Create an account on social media platforms to advertise products. Collaborate with micro and famous influencers to market your products to their following list. Influencer marketing is a hot new trend. It’s a mutually beneficial contract that the influencer and brand agree on. You can also market your products through paid advertisements and pop-ups on jewelry blogs. eCommerce Platforms to Sell Jewelry Online eCommerce platforms help you design your online store from scratch. It has numerous automated features that aid in managing your store. It is more cost-effective to sell jewelry through your store than online marketplaces like Etsy or Amazon. Here are the top 5 eCommerce platforms you can choose from to launch your online store. 1. Create a Seamless User-experience with WooCommerce The customer is shopping for jewelry from an online store because they expect the utmost convenience. WooCommerce has a range of themes and templates that increase the page’s appearance and make it easier for visitors to navigate through the website. WooCommerce comes with improved tools and extensions that further help determine the store’s design. Offering flexibility to your customers regarding website navigation, checkout process, etc., WooCommerce will help you curate an optimal user experience . 2. Sell Expensive Jewelry with Magento  Shoppers need to trust your brand to purchase expensive products from your online store. It means ensuring the security of sensitive customer data and facilitating safe transactions.  Magento has a robust inbuilt security system that addresses all the safety concerns of the buyer and seller to make room for fair trade. It frequently releases security patches for payment gateways to protect it from hackers and fraudulent payments. Other security systems include the Magento Firewall, launching HTTP, implementing secure OWASP or Open Web Application Security Project. You may also add additional extensions to increase the security of your online store. 3. Add High-quality Product Pages with BigCommerce When selling items like jewelry, eCommerce businesses should satisfy customer curiosity. They need detailed, optimum-quality product images from all possible angles. Patrons will engage with vibrant and extravagant pictures of jewelry, positively impacting the website’s SEO ranking.  BigCommerce allows merchants to add product descriptions  and a direct checkout button to increase the company’s sales organically. To further amplify the aesthetic appeal of your product page, you can  customize it through free themes offered by BigCommerce .  4. Customize Your Storefront with Shopify  Shopify is the best eCommerce platform for small businesses . It equips you with different abilities that let eCommerce business owners customize their storefront from scratch to make it suitable to sell jewelry. It has readily available shop themes to design your store in a few minutes. There are thousands of add-ons available on the internet to improve the appearance and  performance of your online Shopify store . It also has an efficient checkout process that’s proven to decrease the rate of your store’s abandoned cart significantly. 5. Advertise Your Handmade Jewelry with Shift4Shop Shift4Shop is an easy-to-use platform that requires little or no coding knowledge. It decreases the cost of hiring a developer to create your online store. Shift4cart lets you set a minimum or maximum order for each piece of handmade jewelry. It also allows customers to bulk order from your store. Handling handmade jewelry can be tricky because of its fragility. However, Shift4shop enables you to choose and integrate any shipping method of your choice to the official storefront.  6. Hassle-free Jewelry Order Management with Wix Wix provides top-level omnichannel experience with the help of an efficient order management system. It has an organized design that handles demand, supply, and retail distribution in one place. It helps you keep track of your orders and inventory. It also provides you with essential information that will aid you in enhancing your online business. Wix also performs chores such as improving stock visibility across the supply channels, tagging jewelry with a unique identification number, analyzing profit margins, etc. Confused about which platform to employ for your jewelry business? Talk To Experts Best Practices for Designing Your Jewelry Product Pages 1. Choose an Attractive Layout The layout of the page determines its base design. Aim to choose a page layout that’s attractive yet elegant. Too many designs are distractions and a terrible idea for jewelry websites. Opt for clean colors like off-white, grey, or neutrals. Ensure your page is free of excessive banner ads, pop-ups, and links. 2. Responsive Design Your online store should be mobile-friendly. Consumers use their smartphones to buy necessities like groceries and luxury items like jewelry. Therefore, it’s vital to ensure that your online store is compatible with all mobile phones. Search engines like Google use mobile-friendliness as a critical SEO ranking factor. 3. CTAs and Images Since consumers can’t feel the product, they rely on the images uploaded by the customers to judge their quality. While selling items like jewelry, you must add supreme quality images on hot product pages. Business owners should also add one or two CTAs or motivational pictures on the page to encourage customers to buy the articles. Tips to Optimize Your Jewelry Product Page to Boost Sales 1. Focus on Your Brand Most shoppers visit your website through landing pages. Some don’t make it to the home page to know your brand and what it sells. Optimize all your web pages to highlight your company. This way, the customer can figure out the details of your eCommerce business by just skimming through the pages. It builds a positive brand reputation motivating customers to start shopping immediately. 2. Product Descriptions Since you are not physically present to market your jewelry or explain the intricate details, customers rely on your product descriptions to do the same. Ensure to write creative product descriptions that humanize the jewelry. It will help customers build an emotional connection with your product, ultimately inspiring them to make it their own.  3. Video Content Video content has the highest consumption rate than other forms of content. 90% of shoppers report that short product videos have encouraged them to buy the article. eCommerce business owners can hire professionals to curate a video advertising their jewelry. It can be added after the product images or even posted on social media as part of advertising campaigns. Creating a Marketing Strategy to Sell Jewelry Online 1. Social Media Building a solid social media presence is essential to implement marketing strategies to sell jewelry online. Social media apps like TikTok, Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook are ideal for advertising jewelry. You don’t have to open an account on all platforms at once. Instead, choose the best option and focus on building that account for better optimization. Use hashtags, video content, dynamic pictures, and music to enhance your campaigns. 2. Newsletter An email newsletter helps reach potential customers and convert them into buyers. It can be released bi-monthly/ monthly or bi-weekly/ weekly. It should contain the latest information about your online stores, such as newly launched collections and updates from the jewelry industry. At the end of the newsletter, add a referral or discount code to persuade the reader to buy something.  3. Content Marketing Content marketing and SEO are part of a robust marketing strategy. Hire experts to develop written videos and images for your jewelry store. It will help in improving the engagement and conversion rate of your business. Implement best SEO practices to ensure your store has increased visibility on search engine result pages. Targeted and relevant keywords also boost your SEO rank on Google. Consider trying your luck starting a customized online jewelry store Click Here Finals Thoughts on Selling Jewelry Online Precious metals still represent wealth, power, and status in our society. According to statistics, the fashion jewelry market value reached approximately $60 billion in 2021. So if you are planning to get into the jewelry business, there is no better time than right now. The market share and consumer base for shopping jewelry online will grow in the upcoming months or years. Furthermore, the increase in technical support by eCommerce platforms has empowered merchants to expand their business exponentially. This blog is a comprehensive guide that entails all details you will need to start or grow your online jewelry business. Selling Jewelry Online – Frequently Asked Question (FAQs) Can you make a profit by selling jewelry online? Yes, selling jewelry online is significantly profitable. Jewelry is a crucial accessory in the fashion industry, and its demand continues to grow. This multi-billion dollar industry is estimated to be worth more than 277 billion by 2027. You will have ample bandwidth for selling jewelry in the marketplace.  What kind of jewelry can I sell online? eCommerce business owners can sell any type of jewelry online; the varieties are limitless. For convenience, the jewelry sector can be divided into eight categories: Engagement and Wedding, Fast Fashion, Vintage, Plated, Handmade, Body, Ethical, and Fine Jewelry. You can also sell specific necklaces, rings, bracelets, or earrings.  Is it better to sell jewelry through an online store or an online marketplace? The answer differs from merchant to merchant. In the long run, it’s better to open an online store to sell jewelry as it cuts down several third-party expenses. As a temporary gig, online marketplaces are a suitable option if you have enough capital for it. Online marketplaces can be limited to specific locations, while online stores are global.  Where can I source my jewelry? Finding reliable jewelry suppliers has become more accessible with increasing popularity and demand. You can harness the power of search engines to locate suppliers near you. Merchants also connect with wholesale suppliers through online platforms like Amazon and Aliexpress. You can also employ people to create jewelry for your brand with sufficient resources.  Is dropshipping jewelry a bad idea? No, it’s not. On the contrary, jewelry dropshipping is a fool-proof idea. You don’t have to spend a single penny from your pocket for this business. Instead, you gain money by connecting buyers to sellers and shipping it to the consumers. Small jewelry items are easy to send. This factor has considerably increased the growth of the jewelry dropshipping business . How should I price my jewelry? Numerous factors contribute to deciding the price of the jewelry. Some of them are the core materials, gemstones used (if any), vintage elements, manufacturing charges, shipping charges, and so on. Ensure that you don’t charge an exorbitant amount as it will drive away your customers. You will make a good profit margin with a suitable price with each sale.  Is it better to sell or pawn jewelry? It depends on your immediate requirements. If you require quick money, pawning your jewelry is better. However, selling your jewelry to authentic brands will ensure you get a fair market rate. Pawnshop owners may sometimes cheat you out of your money. There is the only minimal risk when you choose to sell your jewelry. How do you persuade consumers to buy your jewelry online? Figure out your target audience before implementing any marketing or advertising strategies. Next, utilize the power of social media and email marketing to connect with an extensive set of audiences. Offering lucrative discounts on their first purchase or building loyalty programs will motivate the customers to make definite first buys.  How do I sell jewelry on Instagram? Instagram’s brand new feature, ‘reels,’ has boosted the power of online marketing campaigns. It’s a short video of a maximum of fifteen seconds, and brands use it to showcase their jewelry. They also add engaging captions with product details, relevant hashtags, and sometimes discount codes to increase sales. You could also collaborate with popular influencers.  Can blogs help in marketing my jewelry? Blogs are a vital component of SEO and content marketing strategies. Adding jewelry blogs to your online store will help visitors find relevant and comprehensive information about metals, rare stones, making of jewelry, etc. However, for this strategy to work, ensure you write a high-quality blog with credible data and statistics. Master the art of finding BigCommerce apps that best fit your eCommerce store Click Here Optimizing BigCommerce Stores With BigCommerce Apps for Improved Sales Online shopping has become an integral part of our mundane lives. 96% of Americans shop online, with at least a quarter of them buying necessary stuff off websites every week. Launching an eCommerce store has never been easier, especially with eCommerce platforms like BigCommerce to support them. However, ensuring your store doesn’t get lost in a sea of other online competitor brands can be pretty tricky. One way to get ahead of the competition and overpower the market is by optimizing your BigCommerce store with BigCommerce app integrations. This eCommerce platform has more than 300 technology partners that deliver personalized and efficient solutions for your store. One can perform assorted functions by using these easy-to-install apps. For example, make the administrative process manageable, create coupon code pop-ups to encourage visitors to buy from your store before exiting, develop loyalty programs like incentivizing customers who repurchase from your store, etc. Top 20 BigCommerce Apps to Increase Sales BigCommerce App store has a plethora of options available to aid you in finding the turnkey solution for your store. Below are the top 20 BigCommerce apps merchants favor to boost their online store sales and handpicked by us for your reference. 1. Omnisend In the past five years, marketers around the globe have acknowledged and emphasized the importance of email marketing for any eCommerce store. It is one of the primary tools of marketing that will always stay in trend. Omnisend is a robust email marketing tool necessary for the success of any digital marketing strategy. This marketing tool automatically sends out promotional emails to your target audience, Push or SMS notifications to build relationships with your customers, build a loyal consumer base, acknowledge transactions, and save up to at least 20% of orders in abandoned shopping carts. Engaging with your existing customers is crucial in ensuring repurchases to boost your business sales. Omnisend provides you with unique email template options to customize the emails before sending them to your customers. 2. Privy Privy currently supports more than 500,000 businesses globally and generates an estimated $3.9 billion in sales. Many BigCommerce merchants highly recommend integrating this app with your online store. The central function of Privy is to facilitate interaction between buyers and shoppers, enhance conversion rates, reduce abandoned carts, grow an email list, and so on. This app equips business owners with essential tools like automatic A/B testing, email marketing integration, coupon code integration, real-time tracking, and analytics. Small and large-scale online stores improve sales because of the app’s design. Furthermore, you don’t require prior experience coding to operate this app. Note that this app contains both paid and free features that you can utilize to boost your sales. 3. Shogun Page Builder  Each online store requires a terrific site that excels in appearance and experience. Shogun Page Builder lets you customize your website with the help of a drag and drop option. You can effortlessly create attractive product pages, blog pages, landing pages, homepage, etc. Moreover, you can also utilize A/B testing to understand which themes and designs suit your BigCommerce store.  Shogun also comprises a visual analytics suite to aid you in monitoring sales bounce rates, add-to-cart rates, and form submits. A visually appealing store with a seamless user experience can significantly increase the conversion rate. Shogun is only a website-building app, but it complements other marketing tools and optimizes the conversion funnel. This feature has made the app quite popular among BigCommerce merchants.  4. Wishlist Plus by Swym Unfortunately, only a fraction of shoppers purchase something on their first visit to a new store. Multiple factors contribute to this. An efficient solution to ensure customers buy from your store on their next stop is to remind them of previously liked and searched products from your store. Offer your customers a wishlist option where they can save their preferred products.  Wishlist Plus by Swym is an innovative marketing tool that helps customers keep track of their favorite products by bookmarking them. So the next time they visit your store, they can easily access these objects and proceed to buy them. Statistical data conclude that websites that use Wishlist Plus by Swym see a 20% – 30% hike in conversion rate, and customers are more likely to spend 50% more on their orders.  5. S Loyalty  Every business should have a loyal consumer base as it helps advertise your business and increase sales. Faithful customers talk about your online store to their friends and family and encourage them to shop from your store. This word-of-mouth advertising strategy is the cheapest yet most practical form of advertisement in the books.  eCommerce businesses typically tend to spend a tremendous amount of money and time enhancing relationships with loyal customers and managing them. S Loyalty is a consumer loyalty management app that simplifies handling consumer bases and increases sales much cheaper. It helps BigCommerce businesses manage different loyalty programs to please devoted customers and offer them customized rewards or coupons to encourage them to repurchase from your website.  6. Marcello It is one of the best BigCommerce apps for relevant marketing. In a nutshell, it is an omnichannel marketing app that uses crucial data, professional expertise, and automation for targeted retention marketing. It leverages the power of email marketing, SMS notifications, data-driven automation, and loyalty programs to execute highly efficient segmented marketing campaigns. Years of marketing research prove that focused or targeted campaigns yield higher ROI.  Marcello turns your potential customers into buyers and your existing consumers into loyal clients with its promotional tools to ensure continuous repurchases in the future. Additionally, you can personalize the messages and emails for your shoppers for relevant engagement and retention. Many eCommerce businesses have witnessed a drastic increase in sales with the help of Marcello’s impeccable marketing features.  7. FOMO This app derives its quirky name from Gen Z’s regularly used slang. FOMO stands for Fear Of Missing Out. This concept is brilliantly employed in marketing to improve sales in business. FOMO focuses on consumer psychology and behavior to use them to sell a product. In a nutshell, it taps into the fear of customers and utilizes it to encourage them to make purchases from your store.   It notifies potential customers of the latest products in the market. It lets them know about other customers buying the same items through CTA (Call-to-action) buttons and messages, thereby creating a social demand for the product. The customer will automatically be tempted to add the product to the cart and buy it. 8. Tidio Live Chat Live chats are consumer support systems that are necessary for all eCommerce businesses. Customers may be fickle-minded and require the help of experts to guide them to make a purchasing decision. Online stores offer their customers help by integrating a Live Chat app. Tidio Live Chat app is renowned in the BigCommerce world for its easy-to-use features and simple integration. You can design a fully-featured modern chat option with a responsive design for mobiles and desktops in just a few minutes. This app also lets you curate different scenarios with automated replies to rapidly resolve customer queries even before the consumer support expert interacts with them. 9. Klaviyo  While several other marketing software promises to deliver outstanding results for growing your business, most of them fall short. Klaviyo is a BigCommerce App that grows your online store by giving you valuable insights and information about your customers to help you comprehend them better. This vital data is then converted into relevant and engaging messages to persuade your target audience to shop from your store. Klaviyo amplifies your email marketing efforts to ensure you stay connected with your customers. Shoppers are generally grouped into different categories based on their behavior. For instance, the number of orders, specific products bought, the total amount spent, etc. It tailors targeted email texts according to the requirements of each customer group to increase your eCommerce sales. 10. Smile.io Merchants are scaling back on their advertising and marketing expenses. Instead, they are reallocating their resources to retention marketing efforts. Smile.io increases your business’s revenue by improving the customer retention rate. When you reward your existing customers through referrals, coupons, and other forms of incentives, they will be motivated to repurchase from your business and stay loyal to your brand. Customers need to feel supported and appreciated. Smile.io’s reward programs ensure that they think so. The software helps you create a program based on your online store’s design and branding. The software also enables you to generate VIP tiers for long-time customers who have supported your brand. Feeling that your BigCommerce store needs better marketing support apps? We Can Help 11. Google Shopping by Sales and Orders  Google shopping by sales and orders is a phenomenal tool used by many small and large companies worldwide. Getting on Google Shopping is an essential step in everyone’s business endeavors as it connects you to many BigCommerce stores like Google, Microsoft, Facebook, and Instagram. Consequently, you can import products to other sister platforms with the snap of a finger to give you the desired ROI. You can then build and manage your ad campaigns to drive more happy clients to your store.  Furthermore, Google Shopping by Sales and Orders is ideally optimized to guarantee you a hassle-free experience. They have systems that automatically build and submit a product feed to their affiliated networks. Other exceptional features include real-time issue reporting, feed optimization tools, and optimized product advertising and marketing campaigns. 12. Skubana Skubana is easily one of the finest order management platforms available in the market. As you probably know, building a business does not rely solely on the front-end processes. Back-end processes like distribution, shipment, etc., play a critical role in proper store management. Skubana, in turn, increases sales and production efficiency. Sukubana takes care of your inventory and eliminates multiple obstacles many upcoming businesses face. Skubana solves back-end obstacles such as shipping from multiple locations, instantly determining cost-effective fulfillment methods, and avoiding overselling. It allows you to seamlessly manage product listing, demand forecasting, and replenishment of products from a dashboard. Skubana removes numerous problems sellers face and enables you to focus on creating a brand and scaling your business.  13. Re:amaze Re:amaze is a revolutionary customer communication platform for ecommerce brands. Efficient customer service is perhaps the best way to solve the problems of unhappy clients. Ideal customer service, from the perspective of your clients, can turn a negative experience around and further secure your brand’s reputation. Re:amaze functions as a new age helpdesk to assess and provide appropriate client support. They have pre-built and custom bots, status pages, live chat features, frequently asked questions, and many other attributes to amalgamate your support needs. You can also opt for automated sales and marketing tasks like traffic monitoring and feedback surveys to help remove the extra burden off your shoulders. They integrate well with Bigcommerce, which means you will have immediate access to order data and other features for profitable interactions. 14. Refersion Refersion is one of the top affiliate marketing platforms available. Affiliate marketing is a booming channel for brands. Affiliate marketing helps promote your brand flexibly and cost-effectively. It significantly reduces the amount of money used on advertising and consequently increases your gross return on ad spends.  Refersion allows you to effectively recruit, pay, and track your affiliates with their user-friendly platform. Refersion also provides a pool of over 5000 members ready to join you. With a young budding business hoping to expand, you must have an app like Refersion in your back pocket. They substantially lower the burden of getting into affiliate marketing and let you focus solely on scaling your business and increasing your sales. 15. Sezzle Sezzle is the only certified alternative payment platform with the buy now, pay later option for interest-free installments. Buy now pay later allows customers with the unique experience of purchasing while also giving them extra time to make the payment. This feature has proved to increase your company’s sales, customer acquisition, and client engagement.  Sezzle is a secure checkout option that increases consumers’ financial accessibility to shopping online. Sezzle makes online purchases accessible for those consumers without credit cards, thereby opening up a stratosphere of stores to choose from. Opting for this application will boost your AOV and sales by providing your clients with different risk-free payment options. 16.ReCharge If you want to grow your business as a subscription management service, look no further than ReCharge. In a world of uber-successful companies and enterprises, subscriptions are a thriving area for eCommerce. They are the most straightforward ways to increase customer engagement and keep existing customers. Furthermore, subscription services significantly increase the lifetime value of your customers.  ReCharge helps remove multiple burdens commonly faced by subscription services with their vast multitude of features. Some of the features that differentiate ReCharge from the herds are easy swaps, skips, and reschedules. They also have seamless payment methods on all major processors to facilitate easy transactions. 17. Yotpo  Yotpo (SMSbump) is a great marketing tool many successful businesses use. They are an SMS marketing automation app with impressive results under their belt. They have an excellent click-through rate and  25 times return on investment. Adding SMS marketing from Yopto to your list of marketing campaigns can help boost sales and customer engagement. You can engage your customers in a one-on-one conversation quickly and efficiently.  Yotpo (SMSbump) comes integrated with BigCommerce, so now you can use custom filters to help better target your intended segment. Data received from behavioral triggers and analysis are also at your disposal. This data will enable narrow targeting, resulting in better sales and increased customer accusations. 18. Alloy Automation Alloy automation is a breakthrough automation platform that takes care of your marketing, customer service, shipping, fulfillment, and other previously manual tasks. They take care of the daily tasks of running a BigCommerce store and let you focus on building and scaling your brand. You no longer need to spend valuable time and money hiring an assistant to help run your store’s hectic daily operations.  Looking for help integrating apps to your eCommerce store to run your business smoothly? Contact Us Eighty other apps like Shiphero and Gorgias come integrated with Alloy Automation that fit right into your current tech lineup. These applications help lower the burden of running a store. Unlike many other automation platforms, Alloy Automation integrates with other BigCommerce stores in a few clicks. They have an existing library of over 100 free pre-built workflow recipes to customize your store. 19. Trustpilot Trustpilot is a revolutionary review platform that analyzes customer feedback and turns it into business results. Customer feedback is one of the most neglected tools at a company’s disposal. Honest and truthful reviews ought to be analyzed and worked on to provide the customer with a better experience every time. Working on the reviews builds trust and connection and helps increase sales in the future.  Trustpilot does just that; they work on the reviews and improve your social proof. Trustpilot automatically prompts consumers to leave a review on their order making it easier to collect reviews. They then use these reviews to convert clients that feel they haven’t received ideal service. Doing so increases customer retention and sales. Trustpilot also helps you earn Google Seller rating points to increase clicks on ads, stream reviews, etc. 20. Dotdigital Dotdigital is one of the most outstanding email service providers available today. They provide omnichannel functionality for push notification, SMS, social media, email, live chat, and many more. The benefits of automated and efficient omnichannel marketing can be seen through the immediately increasing sales. You also enjoy higher customer loyalty, retention, and better customer insight, along with growing sales.   They enable brands to engage customers and attain a healthy return on investment. You can use their drag and drop automation builder to create your ideal omnichannel marketing program. They have a user-friendly drag-and-drop automation builder and multiple automation templates to kickstart foundational programs. These features not only reduce the error cost but also increase your return on investment.  BigCommerce Apps Helps You Focus Your Efforts All your businesses must execute targeted marketing and advertising campaigns. Otherwise, it will be a waste of time, money, and effort as it may gain you less ROI or return on investment. Savvy marketers employ innumerable strategic tactics to grow their businesses rapidly. BigCommerce apps play a pivotal role in determining the success of a campaign.  There is a BigCommerce app for every need. With their help, you can enhance the results and impact of your marketing efforts. For instance, if you want to know what and when your customers buy from your store, opt to run an analytic app. This app will give you accurate results on your customer’s behavior, what products they like to buy, when they buy them, etc. You can better align your resources to focus on particular marketing problems like increasing your sales from the gathered data.  Need help with customization of BigCommerce Apps to suit your business needs? Talk To Experts Conclusion To sum up, this blog focuses on one of the most crucial criteria you should keep in mind before choosing an app for your BigCommerce store. The app you select should be based on your target audience and business requirements. Each eCommerce store has unique needs that a single app cannot fulfill. Explore the BigCommerce app store and find more apps that will suit you. All the software mentioned in this blog has shown tangible results in increasing eCommerce business sales . We recommend doing thorough research before subscribing to any app for your BigCommerce store. BigCommerce Apps – Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) How many apps does BigCommerce have? BigCommerce is one of the most prominent Saas eCommerce platforms merchants use globally. This platform equips merchants with state-of-the-art technology and powerful tools to help them expand their eCommerce business. For this, they have third-party integrations like extensions and apps. There are more than 600 BigCommerce apps online.  What are Smile.io reward points? Smile.io helps businesses increase their annual sales by offering exciting revenue to customers. eCommerce businesses can design their referral program based on their preferences. The program provides reward points to the customers if they fulfill specific criteria. Consumers can then redeem these points on their website. How do I integrate Klaviyo into my BigCommerce store? Klaviyo doesn’t have a complicated integration process. Regardless, there are three ways to integrate this software into your BigCommerce store. The first one is through the BigCommerce marketplace, the second through the Klaviyo account setup wizard, and the third through the integration tab in your Klaviyo account.  Is there customer support available for Marcello? Since Marcello is a renowned software, many professional developers and programmers offer support for Marcello. The software itself has an official website with a consumer support channel that gives you unlimited access to expert advice and relevant or helpful articles to help you succeed in your journey.  Is Omnisend expensive? Omnisend is a worthwhile investment to enhance the results of your email marketing efforts. One of the perks of installing this app is its three subscription options. The first one is free, but it only reaches 250 contacts.
